narration: Mvua ikinyesha Moshi, mtandao unakatika. Mapokezi hayawezi kusubiri, wageni wanataka kuingia na kulipa. Operra inafanya kazi hata mtandao ukiwa mdogo, kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza, ili kazi isisimame.

scenes.image: A highland lodge in heavy rain at dusk, Kilimanjaro hidden in grey cloud above banana farms, rain running off a corrugated roof, a guest seen from behind under the porch with a duffel bag. Moody, cinematic photograph.
A warm lodge reception with a glowing stone fireplace and wooden beams, rain on the windows, soft focus, cinematic photograph.
Trekkers seen from behind sitting by a stone fireplace in a highland lodge drinking tea while rain falls outside, cosy, cinematic photograph.
Morning after rain at a highland lodge, the snow cap of Kilimanjaro clear above green banana farms, trekkers seen from behind setting off on a red-earth path, fresh light, cinematic photograph.
